## Pi5 Hub and Secure MCP Tunnel

- Adds a single authenticated Hub with explicit device routing through the Dashboard registry and relay; no implicit target, direct-device fallback, or automatic retry after an unconfirmed operation.
- Adds independent Hub machine authentication, owner-approved device delegation, signed requests and persistent replay protection.
- Adds relay-only device initialization: downstream machines do not need an OpenAI Tunnel Client.
- Keeps terminal ownership stable across OAuth MCP transport sessions, while separating users, clients, devices and privilege levels.
- Distinguishes device-reported failures from interrupted relay responses, and adds OAuth metadata/resource-alias compatibility fixes.

## Deployment

Hub deployment is opt-in. Installing an archive does not automatically migrate devices, enroll them, replace services or rotate credentials. See [Pi5 Hub](https://github.com/jamie950315/Executor/blob/v0.4.0/docs/PI5_HUB.md) and the [migration reference](https://github.com/jamie950315/Executor/blob/v0.4.0/docs/HUB_MAIN_MIGRATION.md). Adapt reference paths and service names to your environment. Do not run multiple Tunnel Clients against the same Tunnel ID.

The reference deployment passed ChatGPT file write/read checks on Pi5, macOS, Debian WSL and Windows, plus session-lifecycle and error-handling checks. Startup settings and independent service starts were verified; a full four-host cold reboot was not performed. Desktop control requires a logged-in, unlocked desktop. Hub session bindings remain in memory and do not survive a Hub restart.

## Artifacts

Source: `83ad3ec4218272ba7fec99dd2e154aef625eb732`.

Six macOS/Linux/Windows amd64/arm64 archives and `SHA256SUMS.txt`, built by [Release CI](https://github.com/jamie950315/Executor/actions/runs/35058424015). [Go CI](https://github.com/jamie950315/Executor/actions/runs/35052857912) passed native Windows/macOS/Linux tests.

**Signing limits:** GitHub-built macOS apps are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Windows binaries are not Authenticode-signed. Publication does not reinstall or restart existing devices.
